title: feat: redeploy code agents after every enter production deploy
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Code agents run a copy of the enter runtime frozen at upload time. Runtime fixes such as the agent error passthrough (#14986, #14999) never reached the 5 deployed agents; CloudCompile's public agent still returns the removed "Agent produced no response".

- Adds `POST /api/admin/code-agents/redeploy`: re-uploads every code agent at its pinned owner commit with the current runtime and lists per-agent failures
- Calls it from `Deploy / Cloudflare production` after the enter deploy (token read from the existing SOPS prod secrets, no new secret)
- Owner code is not changed: the pinned `deployedCommitSha` is kept, unlike the owner sync route which pulls HEAD
- Test: one agent redeployed, one with a missing agent.ts reported as failed

Addresses #14994

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Fresh runtime, same agent
gist.blurb: Code agents now get a fresh copy of the enter runtime after every production deploy, while keeping their owner code pinned exactly where it was. The hive upgrades the plumbing without rearranging anyone’s garden.
gist.summary: Added POST /api/admin/code-agents/redeploy and wired it into the Cloudflare production deploy so every deployed code agent is re-uploaded with the current enter runtime while retaining its pinned deployedCommitSha.
gist.impact: Runtime fixes, including improved agent error passthrough, now reach all deployed agents after production releases without pulling newer owner-code HEAD commits; redeploy failures are reported per agent.
